desc: Route F blurred peripheral observation interface preregistration — no implementation, no simulation
patch: 1J9_patch — clarified 1J10 audit vs 1J11 policy gating, added leakage probe controls (base_rate, CV, shuffle, real-minus-shuffle gap), split hidden_subtype probe into A1 (per-category) and A2 (majority/minority), softened MCTS wording from prerequisite to likely useful substrate

shortcut_context.hidden_category_shortcut_risk: structural — if category-level information becomes available, simple majority-subtype prediction captures nearly entire oracle gap
shortcut_context.public_category_shortcut_assessment: not deployable under current visible features
shortcut_context.route_f_implication: Route F must not convert the hidden-category diagnostic risk into a deployable public shortcut

layer_0_focal.description: Full public visible features of the focal object. Existing interface, unchanged.

layer_1_near_peripheral.description: Coarse information about unvisited objects within distance d1 of focal object

layer_2_mid_peripheral.description: Lower-resolution information about objects between d1 and d2

layer_3_background.description: Aggregate distribution across all remaining unvisited objects beyond d2

F_low.description: Minimal peripheral information — only immediate neighbors

F_mid.description: Moderate coarse local context — small neighborhood

F_high.description: Stronger local context — larger perceptual field, higher leakage risk

preregistered_blur_variants.note: These variants are preregistered, not performance-tuned. They represent different points on the information/leakage tradeoff curve.

blur_rules.monotonic: farther objects receive monotonically less information
blur_rules.lossy: cannot reconstruct exact hidden or true labels from peripheral signals
blur_rules.layer_consistent: same blur function applies to all policies using Route F interface

leakage_audit_plan.timing: Block 1J10 (audit block — implements peripheral_signal, runs leakage tests, makes no C15F policy claim)

leakage_probe_controls.overfitting_note: If accuracy exceeds base_rate+0.10 but real_minus_shuffle_gap < 0.05, classifier is overfitting not detecting genuine leakage — treat as PASS with note

A1_per_category_hidden_subtype_probe.description: Within each public/visible category group, train classifier to predict hidden_subtype from peripheral signal alone. Avoids confounding subtype leakage with category-level signal — global subtype labels are category-specific.
A1_per_category_hidden_subtype_probe.threshold: within-group accuracy ≤ within-group base_rate + 0.10, AND real_minus_shuffle_gap < 0.05 for fail
A1_per_category_hidden_subtype_probe.fail_implication: Peripheral leaks subtype within category — redesign blur

A2_global_majority_vs_minority_probe.description: Train classifier to predict majority-subtype vs minority-subtype (binary) from peripheral signal alone, across all objects regardless of category. Tests subtype typicality leakage without category-specific labels.
A2_global_majority_vs_minority_probe.threshold: accuracy ≤ base_rate + 0.10, AND real_minus_shuffle_gap < 0.05 for fail
A2_global_majority_vs_minority_probe.fail_implication: Peripheral encodes subtype typicality — if A2 fails but A1 passes for all categories, peripheral may encode coarse category structure (allowed) rather than true subtype (forbidden)
A2_global_majority_vs_minority_probe.A2_fail_A1_pass_note: Investigate whether signal is category-level (allowed) or subtype-level (forbidden) before deciding

B_true_affordance_probe.description: Train classifier to predict any true affordance label from peripheral signal alone
B_true_affordance_probe.threshold: per-affordance accuracy ≤ base_rate + 0.10, AND real_minus_shuffle_gap < 0.05 for fail

C_hidden_category_probe.description: Train classifier to predict hidden_category from peripheral signal alone

D_public_category_like_recheck.description: Recompute public-category-like baseline with peripheral information
D_public_category_like_recheck.fail_implication: Shortcut became deployable — redesign or reject

E_C0b_saturation.description: Run C0b observe-only under Route F interface

F_oracle_gap.description: Compute oracle-C0b gap under Route F
F_oracle_gap.fail_implication: Probing has no room to matter — reject Route F

marginal_value_audit.timing: Block 1J10 Part 2 — after leakage audit passes. C15F policy evaluation only in Block 1J11 if both parts pass.

policy_evaluation_plan.condition: Only if Block 1J10 leakage audit AND marginal-value audit both pass. Block 1J10 is the audit block — it implements peripheral_signal and runs audits but makes no C15F policy claim. C15F policy evaluation happens in Block 1J11.
policy_evaluation_plan.block_1J10_role: audit only — implement peripheral_signal, run leakage audit, run marginal-value audit, no C15F policy claim
policy_evaluation_plan.block_1J11_role: C15F policy evaluation — only if 1J10 audits pass

C15B_original_interface.description: C15B from 1J7 — null result vs C15b

policy_evaluation_plan.labeling_rule: Baselines must be clearly labeled with _RouteF or _original_interface suffix. Never mix interfaces without explicit labeling.

proceed_to_C15F_policy_evaluation_in_1J1: all leakage audit tests pass (A1, A2, B, C, D, E, F)
clear preregistered hypothesis tied to object selection and probe targeting
blur parameters fixed before evaluation (not post-hoc tuned)
reject_or_redesign_if: blur parameters selected post-hoc based on C15F performance
peripheral signal quality depends on hidden state access
fallback_options_if_rejected: Simpler observation enhancement (visit-count-based heuristics without peripheral features)
Accept C15b as practical ceiling under current constraints

mcts_relation.route_f_provides: richer low-cost local observations that may support later search-tree-like policies
mcts_relation.breadth_expansion_analogue: peripheral local context (Layers 1-3) — cheap, lossy information about many objects
mcts_relation.depth_expansion_analogue: focal observe/probe (Layer 0) — expensive, precise information about one object
mcts_relation.future_interleaved_policies: may be considered after Route F passes audits (richest substrate), OR if Route F is rejected — an interleaved-only diagnostic (without peripheral information) may still be tested using focal observations alone to guide breadth-vs-depth decisions

final_recommendation.next_block_description: Route F leakage audit + marginal-value audit on seed=101
